# Monocypher 4.0.3

These files are unmodified copies of Monocypher 4.0.3, tag commit
`ab2b16d`, from https://monocypher.org/ and
https://github.com/LoupVaillant/Monocypher.

Included files: `monocypher.c`, `monocypher.h`,
`monocypher-ed25519.c`, and `monocypher-ed25519.h`.

Monocypher is dual-licensed under BSD-2-Clause or CC0-1.0. See
`LICENCE.md` in this directory. This project uses it under BSD-2-Clause.
